newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt back in wheat market, seeks 50,000 T.
newsitem.headline: Egypt back in wheat market, seeks 50,000 T.

text.p: The Egyptian government's main wheat buyer said on Tuesday he was back in the market, seeking bids for 50,000 tonnes of Argentine, U.S. or French wheat for loading in March or April.
Samir Shakankiri, vice-chairman of the state's General Authority for Supply Commodities, told Reuters the wheat could be of any variety. The loading date would be at the buyer's option, he added.
The deadline for bids is 8 a.m. local (0600 GMT) on Saturday, February 1, he said.
The authority reserves the right to cancel the tender at any time without giving a reason, he added.
"I'd like to enter the market," Shakankiri said.
